responsibility: Defines the generic XCOFF object-format configuration layer used by rs6000 targets such as AIX. It switches the backend to XCOFF/COFF conventions, sets assembler and identifier restrictions, configures section and common-symbol emission, EH and DWARF relocation formats, function/object naming and aliasing behavior, TOC pool entry policy, profiling symbol naming, and numerous target asm hooks for XCOFF-specific section selection and symbol output.
